name: Minesweeper
summary: Clear a nine-by-nine board without hitting a mine.
description: Launch Minesweeper from the apps menu (or type /minesweeper) and clear the board together - tap to reveal, or switch to flagging to mark a mine. The first tap is always safe. Ten mines in eighty-one cells, and the field is rebuilt from a seed each frame to keep the shared state short. The seed is in that state, so anyone who reads it can work the mines out; this is a game to play together, not one with hidden information. Press 'new game' for a fresh field.

changes: Each launch gets its own board instead of the same one every time.
Numbers are drawn on revealed cells, and revealed cells stand out from hidden ones.

author: slim-m
